title: Billing and Coding: Application of Bioengineered Skin Substitutes to Lower Extremity Chronic Non-Healing Wounds

codes.1: Note : Providers are reminded to refer to the long descriptors of the CPT codes in their CPT book. The following CPT/HCPCS codes outlined in this Billing and Coding Article will not have diagnosis code limitations applied at this time.
